Making Tax Digital for Income Tax from 6 April 2027: incomes over £30,000

Who starts in April 2027 and when the quarterly updates are due

Sole traders and landlords with qualifying income over £30,000 in the 2025 to 2026 tax year use Making Tax Digital for Income Tax from 6 April 2027. Submit's Income Tax filing awaits HMRC recognition. Submit files VAT returns now.

File a VAT return

Who starts on 6 April 2027

The rule covers sole traders and landlords who are registered for Self Assessment, when their qualifying income is over £30,000.

£30,000 for the 2025 to 2026 tax year, you will need to use it from 6 April 2027

Quarterly updates

Send an update for each quarter by its deadline. These are the standard update periods.

Update period Deadline
6 April to 5 July 7 August
6 April to 5 October 7 November
6 April to 5 January 7 February
6 April to 5 April 7 May, in the following tax year
Source: the table on gov.uk/guidance/use-making-tax-digital-for-income-tax/send-quarterly-updates Retrieved 13 November 2026

Final declaration

The tax return for the year follows the quarterly updates.

You must submit your tax return by 31 January following the end of the relevant tax year, but you can submit it earlier.

gov.uk/guidance/use-making-tax-digital-for-income-tax/submit-your-tax-return Retrieved 13 November 2026
